name: East Riding of Yorkshire
description: East Riding of Yorkshire is a largely rural county surrounding Hull and stretching from the Yorkshire Wolds to the North Sea coast. It is known for fertile agricultural land, dramatic coastal scenery and historic market towns such as Beverley.

places.name: East Riding of Yorkshire
places.description: A large rural district covering the Yorkshire Wolds' chalk hills and coastal towns, with the historic market town of Beverley at its heart.

places.name: City of Kingston upon Hull
places.description: A port city on the Humber estuary, historically built on fishing and maritime trade, and birthplace of anti-slavery campaigner William Wilberforce.
